events.title: HIPHOP NIGHT: DJBJ 3525 & DJ DONO (OPEN FORMAT CLUB HITS)
events.description:
If you haven't been to a Hip Hop Night at Big Pink yet, let us put you on...

We've got DJBJ 3525 & DJ DONO playing your favorite hip-hop hits, throwbacks & club bangers all night long! No sections, no booths, no bottle service. Just good music & a dance floor full of people ready to have a good time.

Hip Hop Night has become one of our favorite parties for a reason! Grab some FREE tickets for you & your crew, lock in your plans & we'll see you on the dance floor!

21+

Message @bigpinklovesyou on Instagram with any questions.

events.title: CUFFING SZN: DJ MOCHI & COMPLETD (R&B + DANCE MUSIC)
events.description:
It's getting colder outside, which means CUFFING SZN is officially here! So it's only right we bring one of our favorite parties back to Big Pink!

Whether you're single, taken, or somewhere in between, we've got you covered! Expect blends of hip-hop, R&B & dance music all night. Think Kaytranada blended with SZA and everything in between. Bring your boo, your situationship, or your besties & meet us on the dance floor!

Limited FREE tickets available now, grab yours while you can!

21+

Message @bigpinklovesyou on Instagram with any questions.
